summary: MPLS networks have many MIB modules for management, each in its own document. This informational RFC gives an overview of the MIB modules used to manage the MPLS Transport Profile (MPLS-TP) and how they fit together.

eli5.summary: Many different instruction booklets exist for running one machine. This is the table of contents saying which booklet to read.
